50-``` 51- 52-Here's how the example above works: 53- 54:- By default, the outer `div` is `display: block`, but by adding the `md:flex` utility, it becomes `display: flex` on medium screens and larger. 55:- When the parent is a flex container, we want to make sure the image never shrinks, so we've added `md:shrink-0` to prevent shrinking on medium screens and larger. Technically we could have just used `shrink-0` since it would do nothing on smaller screens, but since it only matters on `md` screens, it's a good idea to make that clear in the class name. 56:- On small screens the image is automatically full width by default. On medium screens and up, we've constrained the width to a fixed size and ensured the image is full height using `md:h-full md:w-48`. 57- 58-We've only used one breakpoint in this example, but you could easily customize this component at other sizes using the `sm`, `lg`, `xl`, or `2xl` responsive prefixes as well. -- 62-Tailwind uses a mobile-first breakpoint system, similar to what you might be used to in other frameworks like Bootstrap. 63- 64:What this means is that unprefixed utilities (like `uppercase`) take effect on all screen sizes, while prefixed utilities (like `md:uppercase`) only take effect at the specified breakpoint _and above_. 65- 66-### [Targeting mobile screens](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/responsive-design\#targeting-mobile-screens) -- 84-``` 85- 86:For this reason, it's often a good idea to implement the mobile layout for a design first, then layer on any changes that make sense for `sm` screens, followed by `md` screens, etc. 87- 88-### [Targeting a breakpoint range](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/responsive-design\#targeting-a-breakpoint-range) 89- 90:By default, styles applied by rules like `md:flex` will apply at that breakpoint and stay applied at larger breakpoints. 91- 92:If you'd like to apply a utility _only_ when a specific breakpoint range is active, stack a responsive variant like `md` with a `max-*` variant to limit that style to a specific range: 93- 94-HTML 95- 96-``` 97:

content.text:
In the Tailwind CSS docs (Responsive Design), the `md` breakpoint defaults to a min-width of **48rem (768px)**. It applies as `@media (width >= 48rem) { ... }`.

The container query variant `@md` is a different thing. It defaults to 28rem (448px).
